entries.content_plain: PSALM 51 Psa 51:1-19 . On the occasion, compare 2Sa 11:12 . The Psalm illustrates true repentance, in which are comprised conviction, confession, sorrow, prayer for mercy, and purposes of amendment, and it is accompanied by a lively faith. 1-4.
